measurement_formula: epsilon_p <= epsilon_cal + epsilon_filter + epsilon_base + R*(Delta/2+tau); conditional on independently justified R and sensor/filter envelope
frequency_formula: E_f <= B0 + norm1(h_hat)*epsilon_P + delta_h1*P_bound + epsilon_f + epsilon_tail
test_units: iid acquisition/session units for one prespecified binary endpoint and target population; not rows, autocorrelated windows, or exchangeability alone
split_policy: pilot/development exposure cannot become confirmation; freeze full session/run groups and reserve entire model/hardware units for transfer before fitting
pre_fit_gate: Report matched channel/time/provenance sufficiency and immutable split to parent BEFORE fitting or large evaluation
required_stopping_outcome: Either sufficient new matched data with frozen split, or explicit unavailable parameters and design-only acquisition protocol. Current outcome is latter.
